requirements.requirement: Tests-disabled `bpr` installs and runs without desktop/GUI/display dependencies; desktop and core-only builds remain valid.
Desktop and CLI exercise the same tour services, parser, publisher, journal, and normalized result semantics; no duplicate publisher or GUI child process exists.
A human can open, write Problem/Solution, add/reorder/walk/complete stops, preview, and publish without an AI provider or GUI.
Human/JSON outputs, typed errors, paging, exact identifiers, cancellation, and noninteractive refusal obey CLI-CONTRACT.
Every command binds an explicit or unambiguous profile/account/PR/draft/revision; concurrent agent sessions cannot redirect each other through current selection.
Source destinations are pinned and distinguish prose byte ranges from source line ranges, including historical/left/unchanged fallback targets.
Editor/stdin/file operations preserve text, use exact revision checks, release ownership while awaiting an editor, and do not execute repository instructions.
Preview/recover/readiness/local editing make zero GitHub writes; publication uses the exact finite existing plan with explicit confirmation and no unscoped noninteractive bypass.
Native and admitted CLI transports retain host/platform qualification and credential boundaries; unsupported paths refuse honestly.
Killed/interrupted terminal publication and maintenance reconcile known identities without duplicate sends or automatic resume.
Terminal rendering neutralizes untrusted control/escape sequences, reports truncation, and remains usable with no color, narrow width, and Unicode paths.

Separately installable packages include first-run profile/auth setup without the desktop; focused native courses, integration docs and feature discovery distinguish supported from not-yet-qualified platforms.
Cold open from only GitHub reconstructs all available shared content/order/bindings in desktop, CLI and skill without local metadata or AI.
Missing private context is reported as unknown; complete/partial/ambiguous/deleted/stale observations never collapse to empty or fabricated content.
Local WIP saves and cross-interface switches produce zero GitHub writes; staged and submitted material have visibly distinct status and recovery rules.
The same unfinished draft moves CLI → desktop → skill → CLI, retaining text, order, IDs, source/readiness state, baselines and reversible committed edits without copy/import.
CLI commands work against a running desktop through an authenticated, bounded, versioned owner channel, with no second store writer and no mandatory daemon.
Owner/peer replacement, protocol mismatch, duplicate request, uncertain delivery, crash, and stale endpoint cases refuse/reconcile without duplicate local or remote effects.
Dirty buffers, IME, external-editor saves, concurrent fields/structure and stale AI replies preserve authors' text and report conflicts instead of last-writer-wins.
Cross-interface undo/redo is one coherent local transaction history with monotonically advancing revisions, no duplicate editor application, and no network/AI replay.
Cold pending-review discovery, local purge and missing journals never auto-submit/adopt/delete or claim recovery of absent private WIP/authorization.
Website edits, multiple batches/roots, historical anchors, second-machine recovery and profile/account isolation pass common production-path fixtures plus separately recorded native/website evidence.
Skill/package/frontmatter identity is exactly `pr-tour`; canonical distribution uses the existing shared-skill workflow with no divergent implementation copies.
The main skill is a thin, progressively loaded wrapper; GitHub access, draft state, parsing, anchors, publication and recovery all use `bpr tour`.
Activation/capability/version checks and every subsequent call bind explicit returned identities; a missing/incompatible CLI produces no fallback publisher.
The conversation follows manual-first Problem/Solution/individual stops, reuses known answers, and persists accepted user text without bulk unsolicited generation.
The active agent uses the effective four hooks and scoped context/results without nested agents, hardcoded model routes or direct model APIs.
Exact-range rewrite, ambiguity, stale/ABA response, no-op, failed result and undo/redo behavior match desktop/CLI semantics with no mandatory acceptance panel.
Outline-only and individual-stop user interaction are preserved; tool reads are not human visits and acknowledgement provenance is not overstated.
No direct API/DB mutation or fabricated approval exists; publication requires a current explicit user command and the CLI's real authorization path.
Prompt injection, oversized context, forbidden host/provider, private-note exclusion, claimed identity and interrupted-session cases are handled without policy bypass.
Packaged skill smoke tests in supported interactive agent hosts, shared-draft round trips, and human-attended transcript checks are recorded separately from offline fixtures.
